answer: Fingerprint continuity makes cloned identities unprofitable. Each identity builds a fingerprint from its work. A beacon check each epoch compares current behavior with the stored fingerprint; a match below 85% triggers review, and a second mismatch freezes rewards for 6 epochs and slashes 40% of the 150-unit stake. New identities spend 3 epochs on probation under inlet review. A river of clones shares one fingerprint, so one detection flags the whole cluster. Break-even: 1,000 distinct fingerprints need 1,000 work histories at 120 units each, or 120,000 units total.
